# GodotTrench Wiki

A personal canvas wiki for notes, snippets and diagrams. Edit lives on the site and save back to the repo.

## How it works

Each page is a **board**. Cards are placed freely and can be dragged, resized and layered.

Toggle **Edit** in the toolbar to add cards and rearrange them, then press **Save** to commit to GitHub.

Card types: text, code, image, video, table, shape and freehand draw.

### About

GodotTrench is a brush based level editor for Godot, written in Rust. It aims for TrenchBroom parity plus Hammer style entity I/O, prefabs, displacements and a live view into the Godot editor.

This wiki collects notes about it.
